species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 66°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 8–38 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 90 ft, so fish stay above it.
East wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the west shore: try the wind-blown banks.

species.name: Crappie

The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
